Package com.signalwire.sdk.relay

Class RelayClient

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.relay.RelayClient
public class RelayClient extends Object
RELAY WebSocket connection manager.

Manages WebSocket connections to the SignalWire RELAY service using JSON-RPC 2.0. Implements the four correlation mechanisms:

  1. JSON-RPC id -> CompletableFuture for RPC response matching
  2. call_id -> Call for event routing
  3. control_id -> Action per Call for action event routing
  4. tag -> CompletableFuture<Call> for dial correlation

Also handles:

  • Event ACK for every signalwire.event
  • Ping/pong for signalwire.ping
  • Exponential backoff reconnection
  • Authorization state for fast reconnection
  • Server-initiated disconnect with restart flag
  • Dynamic context subscription via receive/unreceive
  • Message tracking by message_id

 var client = RelayClient.builder()
     .project("project-id")
     .token("api-token")
     .space("example.signalwire.com")
     .contexts(List.of("default"))
     .build();

 client.onCall(call -> {
     call.answer();
     var action = call.play(List.of(Map.of("type", "tts",
         "params", Map.of("text", "Hello!"))));
     action.waitForCompletion();
     call.hangup();
 });

 client.run();

    • connect

      public void connect(long timeoutMs)
      Open the WebSocket connection and complete the signalwire.connect handshake without blocking the caller.

      Mirrors the Python RelayClient.connect() coroutine. Tests use this directly; production code typically uses run() instead.

      Parameters:
      timeoutMs - how long to wait for the handshake to complete
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if connect fails or times out

    • sendRaw

      public void sendRaw(Map<String,Object> frame)
      Send a raw JSON-RPC frame on the underlying socket. Production code uses execute(String, Map), which adds project_id/protocol automatically. This helper exists for the porting-sdk RELAY-handshake audit harness, which has to emit a method:"signalwire.event" frame from inside the on-event callback so the fixture's dispatch counter fires (see SUBAGENT_PLAYBOOK lesson on event-ACK semantics).
      Parameters:
      frame - a Gson-serializable map representing the frame
